TAGLINE: Mechanistic Subnetwork Pruning: Diagnosing and recovering from catastrophic layer sensitivity in transformers — scaling to Mistral-7B with true hardware compression.
OVERVIEW: A structured pruning + activation healing pipeline (TIM-MGDT) that identifies which transformer layers and MLP widths are elastic vs critical. By exploiting the 'Hardware-Aligned Structural Lottery Ticket' hypothesis, we prune models like Mistral-7B using FIM metrics while fully preserving zero-shot reasoning (GSM8K) capabilities.

Existing pruning methods either destroy quality or require expensive retraining. We recently tested 'Hardware-Aligned Width Pruning' and discovered the 'Perplexity Trap': FIM metrics based on general text effectively overwrite and destroy rare mathematical reasoning circuits. We are now testing 'Contrastive Circuit Sparing' to surgically isolate and protect these logic pathways.

Phase 17 active. We discovered that Phase 16 width pruning crashed GSM8K reasoning from 38% to 5% because general text FIM actively deletes reasoning neurons. We are now implementing Contrastive Circuit Sparing to protect math circuits during 20% width pruning.
RESEARCH_Q: Can Contrastive Circuit Sparing isolate and protect mathematically dense neurons during 20% width pruning, achieving zero-shot reasoning preservation without expensive LoRA healing?

DECISIONS: We shifted focus entirely from toy models like GPT-2 to Mistral-7B, proving our pipeline on state-of-the-art reasoning architectures used in modern deployments.
FIM Width Pruning over Depth Pruning

Depth pruning (layer dropping) creates sharp, localized discontinuities ('Perplexity Trap'). Width pruning (MLP dimensionality reduction) guided by Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) preserves the structural manifold and retains zero-shot logical reasoning better.
To ensure theoretical FLOP reductions translate to physical speedups, we round pruned MLP dimensions to nearest 64 (Tensor Core alignment) via specific ceil/floor strategies.
TASKS: A smart parallel script is currently utilizing both RTX 3090s to calculate FIM, prune Mistral-7B with `ceil` and `floor` strategies, and evaluate GSM8K zero-shot recovery simultaneously.
